definitions.citation: Structural validity over every non-abstained answer; missing citations fail rather than being excluded.
definitions.unsupported_abstention: Curated unsupported questions must abstain through the unsupported route, not merely fail from missing resources.
definitions.routing: Agreement with curated question-type labels; labels may require review when multiple interpretations are reasonable.

Reviewed annotation status is a reviewer declaration, not proof of review.

Threshold calibration and held-out model comparisons are not performed.
Reported latency includes the actual cold/warm state of this run.
